label: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies

survey.name: intro
label:
**Humanitarian Service Point Mapping**
This form records humanitarian service points and the services they provide.

hint: Yes = record services once, then tick all provinces & districts covered.  No = add each location separately with its own services.
survey.name: same_services
label: Are the SAME services offered across all HSP's?

hint: Enter 0 if there are none. Maximum = number of districts in the selected country (${max_hsps}).
survey.name: num_hsps
label: How many humanitarian service points (HSPs) are there?
survey.constraint_message: The number of HSPs cannot exceed the number of districts in the selected country (${max_hsps}).

hint: Select all IFRC thematic areas provided.
survey.name: services_all
label: Services offered (applies to ALL locations)

hint: Select every province/region where the services above are offered.

hint: Select every district where the services above are offered.

label: Districts where these services are offered

hint: Select all IFRC thematic areas provided here.
survey.name: services_loc
label: Services offered at THIS location

survey.name: ack_intro
label: Please review your entries above before submitting.
